235)༄༅/rdor sems gnas lung brgya stong gsog tshul 'don 'grigs nor bu chu dwangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /rgyal kun spyi gzugs rdo rje sems/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ rdor sems gnas lung brgya stong gsog tshul 'don 'grigs nor bu chu dwangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rgyal kun spyi gzugs rdo rje sems// kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang po gnyis// gcig gam tha dad 'phyang mo nyug /mkhyen rtogs yon tan rgya mtshos so// rgyal po dzaḥnas brgyud pa yi// rdor sems thugs kyi sgrub pa 'di// snga 'gyur pa yi mnog chos yin// pha nor bu yi bdag gir zungs/ 'di nyid kyi cho ga dang 'brel ba'i gnas lung brgya stong gsog par 'dod na/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi'i chas/ rtsa ba'i gtor ma dkar zlum 'dab bzhi/ bskang gtor dkar zlum ril bu zhe gnyis can grangs zhe gnyis/ dpal gtor dmar po mtheb skyu nga brgyad can grangs nga brgyad/ sman brgya/ rakta brgya/ mar me brgya re bcas cho ga tshar re bzhin gsar pa 'bul rgyu dang*/ chu mchod brgya rtsa sogs bsham/ cho ga dngos la shin tu rgyas pa dang khyer bde ba gnyis so/ dang po ni nyin re/ cho ga tshar gnyis re la gnas lung re re sbyar bas gsog pa'o/ gnyis pa ni/ tshig bdun rgyud 'debs/ bsang chu/ dkar bgegs/ yan bdun/ mchod rlabs/ dam tshig pa bskyed/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren/ dbang skur/ mchod bstod/ bzlas dmigs/ yig drug stong*/ yig brgya brgya/ gsol gdab/ nyer bsdu/ gong gi shu n+ya ta= 'khor 'das chos kun= nas bzlas pa/ nyer bsdu yan tshar bzhi zin nas/ mdun skyed/ spyan 'dren/ dbang skur/ phyag 'tshal/ mchod pa/ bstod pa/ bzlas dmigs/ yig drug stong*/ yig brgya brgya/ gsol gdab/ las sbyor/ 236) dmigs bzlas nyer gcig bum snyen nyer gcig bshags pa/ yan lag lhag ma rnams/ dam bca'/ skong chen lnga/ dag 'gyur/ bdag 'jug rgyas pa/ gnang ba nod/ gnas lung gi rten bskyed la/ 'gugs pa/ sbyong ba/ lha khrus/ dug khrus/ 'byung bzhi bcas dang*/ skyabs gsol/ dbang ji ltar nas/ khrus/ maṇḍal/ gsol gdab/ yan bdun/ sdom bzung rgyas bsdus gang mos/

sbyor ba sdig sgrib dag byed dbang rim gsum/ bkra shis yan/ ye shes dbab/ brtan/ maṇḍal/ gsol gdab/ dbang lha drangs nas/ dbang bzhi/ bzlas lung*/ gtso bos ji ltar= maṇḍal bcas/ yang khrus/ rnam dag gtsang dwangs= nas/ 'di yan lnga/ mjug gi byin mchod rlabs/ mchod bstod/ nongs bshags/ nyer bsdu/ oṃ badzra satwa ā: dge bsngo bcas/ phyi chog la/ rgyud 'debs/ bla ma rig 'dzin= bdag skyed tshar bzhi/ mdun skyed dang lnga/ skong ba yan zin nas/ gsol ka ci rigs dang*/ tshogs brlab/ spyan 'dren/ spyir mchod/ mchod bshags btab gsum/ sbyor mchod/ tshogs drang ba/ cha gsum/ rig me dor/ gnang ba zhu/ gnas lung dbu nas bzung*/ khrus 'og ma nas/ dbang skur yan tshar lnga/ zas gtad rgyas pa/ lam bstan bcas/ nyin tha ma/ me sbar/ bzang spyod smon lam sogs/ gdod nas lhun grub= lhag ma gtang*/ gsol ka bskyag chad brtan/ rjes mchog mchod rlabs/ 237) mchod bstod bshags gsum/ rten bzhugs bsdu ldang*/ bsngo smon/ bkra shis bcas bya'o/ rigs 'dus rdor sems cho ga 'di// da lta'i dus na med thabs med// bcas ltung char bzhin 'bab pa la// bshags pa rdor sems 'di nyid zab// skyed rim mang po mi nus la// lha gcig sgom pa shin tu bde// gsang sngags bon gyer mi 'gro ba// cho ga 'di nyid 'don dang 'ong*// zhi khror mi tshe bskyal ba rnams// dam pa rigs brgya'i sku phyag mtshan// ma 'gres da lta shod gyis dang*// dka' bas bon gyer kho na yin// de bas cho ga tshar re las// 'don rgyu ma byung byung phyin chad/ dmigs rim blo la 'dris pa dang*// skyed rdzogs zung 'jug ma nor ang*// 'di las sla ba'i sngags chog med// sla mo 'di la mi 'jug par// dka' mo'i cho gar 'jug pa de// 'phur mi nus pa g.yang mchong 'dra// blo dman rang dang 'dra ba rnams// rang don gzhan don byed dgos tshe// cho ga rdor sems 'di la gyis// rang la tshad pa'i gos gyon 'dra// skye bar bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' dang*// skad cig 'bral med spyi bor rtag bzhugs nas// skye 'chi bar do'i 'jigs pa kun bsal nas// mngon dga'i zhing du 'brel bcas phyin par shog
/zhes pa'ang ye shes lha rgyal gyi 238) gsal 'debs su dpal chen 'dus pa rtsal gyis bris pa dge legs 'phel// bkra shis//
